T: Some people never learn. Some people bring snacks.
D: Dr Grant is tricked into joining a rescue mission to the dinosaur island of Isla Sorna.
P: Serve the snacks when the satellite phone rings inside the spinosaurus.
S: Eric and Ben parasailing over the island

Garlic, chilli and lime prawns threaded on skewers and grilled over high heat, with a sweet mango and red onion salsa. Toss 800g peeled green prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, the zest and juice of 1 lime and 2 tbsp olive oil, and leave for 20 minutes. Thread onto 8 skewers. Dice 2 mangoes with half a red onion, a handful of coriander and the juice of another lime. Grill the skewers over high heat for 2 minutes a side until pink and charred. Serve with the salsa and lime wedges.
Devilled eggs with Dijon and chives, dusted with smoked paprika
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks mashed with mayo, mustard and chives, piped back in, a dusting of paprika on top.
Isla Sorna tostones with garlic lime mojo
Twice-fried green plantain, smashed and salted, with garlic lime mojo

Green plantain fried, smashed flat and fried again until crisp, salted and served with a sharp garlic, lime and coriander mojo. Peel 3 green plantains and cut into 3cm pieces. Fry in oil at 160C for 4 minutes until soft but pale, then drain and smash each flat with a heavy glass. Fry again at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then salt well. For the mojo, mix 3 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of 2 limes, 4 tbsp olive oil, chopped coriander and salt. Serve hot with the mojo for dipping.
M: Ellie's lemon and thyme roast chicken
Grant visiting Ellie and her family at home

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme until the skin crackles, with crisp roast potatoes, honey carrots and pan gravy. Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and thyme, rub with butter and salt, and roast at 200C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil alongside for 50 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with 1 tbsp honey for 35 minutes. Rest the chicken, then stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices with 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick.
Rice and black beans with peppers and coriander, topped with fried eggs
Black beans and rice cooked together with onion, capsicum and coriander, served with fried eggs, plantain and salsa.
W: Small meringue nests filled with whipped cream and passionfruit
Small meringue nests baked at 120C for 60 minutes, filled with cream and passionfruit, three berries in each like eggs.
K: Pineapple, orange and passionfruit juice topped with soda water, no alcohol
Pineapple, orange and passionfruit juice topped with soda water and lots of ice in a big jug.

dishes.n: Isla Sorna tostones with garlic lime mojo

steps.text: Peel the plantains and cut into thick pieces. Mix the garlic, lime juice, olive oil, coriander and a pinch of salt for the mojo.
Fry the plantain at 160C for 4 minutes until soft but pale. Drain and smash each flat with a heavy glass.
Fry again at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then salt well.
Serve hot with the mojo for dipping.

dishes.make_ahead: Rice up to 1 day, fry eggs fresh

steps.text: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil.
Add the rice, beans with their liquid and water. Simmer covered until the rice is tender, then stir through the coriander.
Fry the eggs and mix the tomatoes with a little salt for a fresh salsa.
Serve the rice topped with fried eggs and salsa.

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.
Pipe into small nests and bake at 120C. Cool in the oven.
Fill with whipped cream and passionfruit and add three blueberries to each like eggs.
Pour the pineapple and orange juice into a big jug. Scoop in the passionfruit pulp and stir well.

s.note: Devilled eggs with Dijon and chives, dusted with smoked paprika
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, a spoon of Dijon and snipped chives until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and dust with smoked paprika so they look speckled like eggs from a nest.

s.n: Isla Sorna tostones with garlic lime mojo
s.note: Twice-fried green plantain, smashed and salted, with garlic lime mojo
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains and cut into 3cm pieces. Fry in oil at 160C for 4 minutes until soft but pale, then drain and smash each flat with a heavy glass. Fry again at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then salt well. For the mojo, mix 3 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of 2 limes, 4 tbsp olive oil, chopped coriander and salt. Serve hot with the mojo for dipping.

m.note: Rice and black beans with peppers and coriander, topped with fried eggs
m.how: Soften a diced onion and red capsicum in oil, add 300g rice and a can of black beans with their liquid and 500ml water. Simmer covered until the rice is tender, then stir through coriander. Serve topped with fried eggs and fresh tomato salsa.

w.note: Small meringue nests filled with whipped cream and passionfruit
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Pipe into small nests and bake at 120C for 60 minutes, then cool in the oven. Fill with whipped cream and passionfruit and add three blueberries to each like eggs.

d.note: Pineapple, orange and passionfruit juice topped with soda water, no alcohol
d.how: Pour 1L pineapple juice and 1L orange juice into a big jug. Scoop in the pulp of 3 passionfruit and stir well. Top with 1L cold soda water and plenty of ice. Pour into glasses while waiting for the rescue boat.
